## X-Sense Home Security v1.4.24

This hotfix release removes the remaining Home Assistant device-registry deprecation warnings reported on newer Core versions.

### Home Assistant Compatibility
- Removes the remaining deprecated child-device `via_device` parent-link fallback and uses `via_device_id` instead.
- Keeps parent-device lookup compatible with Home Assistant versions that expose the non-deprecated registry lookup on the registry instance instead of the module helper.
- Adds a regression check so the deprecated `via_device` key is not reintroduced in the shared entity code.
